dedupe_keys.name: portugal sns transparency monthly hospital emergency department attendances by type and manchester triage colour and emergency department characteristics

description: These datasets describe demand on Portugal's public hospital emergency departments and how each department is organised. They are published by the Executive Directorate of the National Health Service (SNS) on its Transparency portal. One gives monthly attendances per hospital from January 2013, split into general, paediatric, obstetric and psychiatric emergencies. A second gives the same attendances by Manchester triage colour, from red to blue and white, which shows the urgency mix arriving at each hospital. A third lists every emergency service with its hospital, address, parish and coordinates, the type of emergency service, the specialities it offers, the age range served and the permitted access routes, such as self-referral or referral by the SNS 24 phone line. All three are free and available to download from the portal in CSV, JSON, Excel, Parquet and GeoJSON, and through its open API. Caveats: counts are monthly and per hospital, not per visit, waiting times are not included, the latest two months are provisional, and only hospitals reporting to the SNS are covered. Simulation uses: setting emergency department demand by hospital, urgency and season, testing closures or diversion of obstetric and paediatric emergencies, and linking to bed capacity. Related records: the SNS bed data (data-sns-portugal-hospital-beds-and-occupancy), the INEM pre-hospital data (data-inem-portugal-prehospital-emergency-activity) and the French emergency department visits (data-drees-emergency-department-daily-visits-2017-2023).
name: Portugal SNS Transparency: monthly hospital emergency department attendances by type and Manchester triage colour, and emergency department characteristics
provider: Direção Executiva do Serviço Nacional de Saúde (DE-SNS), Portugal
schema_summary: By type: tempo, region, institution, location, general, paediatric, obstetric and psychiatric emergency attendances and total (6,481 rows). By triage: period, region, institution, location, attendances by Manchester colour (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, white) and without triage (6,420 rows). Characterisation: region, legal nature, hospital group, hospital unit, location, address, postcode, parish, emergency service name, emergency type, speciality, age range, and access routes (self-referral, SNS 24 line, primary care, emergency or hospital doctors) (1,077 rows)
